biggest_catch: The headline 1% match up to $50,000 requires transferring up to $5,000,000 in existing brokerage assets into SoFi and leaving them untouched for FIVE years. An ordinary user with no other brokerage account earns $0 from this offer — the only no-transfer signup bonus is the separate $25 stock referral offer. The transfer-bonus offer period also ends September 30, 2026.
catches: Qualifying transfers must remain in the SoFi self-directed account for five (5) years from the settlement date to keep the full match; withdrawing early triggers a proportional early-withdrawal fee and removal of the matching amount.
The fee can trigger even when losses (not withdrawals) reduce the balance below the pre-promotion equity + deposit + match, and required IRA distributions can also trigger it.
Offer Period is only September 10, 2026 – September 30, 2026 — about a week left at verification time — and SoFi may modify, suspend, or terminate the offer at any time without advance notice.
Only ACAT transfers qualify — new cash deposits do not earn the match.
This offer may not be combined with any other offers.
The match is treated as taxable income; it is paid in cash but cannot be rolled into anything else.
New SoFi customers qualify only if their self-directed IRA or taxable account is in good standing through SoFi Securities LLC.

steps: Open or confirm a SoFi self-directed IRA (Traditional/Roth) or taxable brokerage account in good standing through SoFi Securities LLC — new accounts qualify.
Initiate an ACAT transfer of assets from your existing brokerage account into the SoFi self-directed account (new cash deposits do not qualify).
Make sure the transferred assets settle before the end of the Offer Period (September 30, 2026); transfers settling later earn nothing.
The 1% match is paid in cash into the receiving account within 5 business days of the settlement date (e.g. $20,000 transferred = $200 match).
Keep the transferred assets in the SoFi account for five (5) years from the settlement date — early withdrawal triggers a proportional fee and removal of matching funds.
timing: Match paid in cash within 5 business days from the date the transferred funds settle; funds must be maintained for five (5) years from settlement to keep the entire match.
